description: 学校の体育館でサイエンスフェアが開かれている。中央では女子生徒が小型ロボットを来場者に実演し、男子生徒がポスターを指さしながら仕組みを説明している。教師がメモを取りながら発表を聞いている。背景では、生徒が顕微鏡で植物の細胞を観察し、別のグループが太陽系の模型を使って説明している。さらに、風力発電の模型を動かしている生徒や、植物の成長実験を紹介している生徒、タブレットで実験結果を記録している生徒もいる。来場した保護者や他の生徒たちが各展示を興味深そうに見ている。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show a lively school science fair taking place inside a bright modern Japanese school gymnasium. The atmosphere should be positive, educational, energetic, and collaborative rather than chaotic. The main event must be immediately clear in the foreground: a teenage schoolgirl is demonstrating a small student-built robot on a display table while several visitors watch with interest. Beside her, a teenage boy is pointing at a large science poster and explaining how the robot works. A teacher holding a clipboard is listening carefully and taking notes while evaluating their presentation. The robot should be clearly visible and should have simple wheels, sensors, and a small mechanical arm. Include several distinct background sub-stories happening simultaneously. On the left, two students are observing plant cells through a microscope, with prepared slides and a simple biology poster nearby. In the middle background, another group is presenting a colorful model of the solar system while one student points to the planets and another visitor listens. On the right, students are demonstrating a small wind-turbine model, using a portable fan to make the blades rotate while another student records the results on a tablet. Nearby, another student is explaining a plant-growth experiment with several small plants of different heights arranged in pots under different light conditions. A student photographer is taking pictures of the displays for the school record. Parents, teachers, and students are walking between exhibition tables and examining the projects with curious expressions. Include school uniforms, presentation tables, posters, notebooks, clipboards, a microscope, plant samples, a solar-system model, a wind-turbine model, a portable fan, tablets, small plants, charts, and the small robot. Make every activity visually distinct and easy to describe. Clear foreground, middle ground, and background. Approximately 12 to 16 visible people. No speech bubbles, no captions that are necessary to understand the image, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, highly detailed but visually organized and uncluttered, expressive faces and gestures, suitable for an English speaking assessment.
